name: Flying an Airplane Game, by Kelvinkit (Clever Games & Toys)
author: kelvinkit123
description: This is a Flying Airplane Game, simulator of real flying in the sky. For the basic control, you can use the ARROW or WASD (UP/W: to turn up) and (DOWN / S : to turn down), controlling the plane to fly through the gap between the obstacles(wall). For advance player, you can even control turn the Airplane Left (LEFT/A : turn left) and right (RIGHT/D : turn right). So, just like a simulator, you can fly in the sky in 360 degree Enjoy the game by Kelvinkit (Clever Games & Toys)
